C9000313.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 313 (Finite generation for the $`K(n)`$-local sphere.; papers: Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FT_PUBLICATION.statement: An independent Reviewer certifies a publishable result and its novelty; a bounded identity or a reconstruction alone does not close the campaign.

C_FT_SPHERE.statement: thm:main: pi_t L_K(n) S_p^complete is finitely generated over Z_p for all primes, positive heights and integer degrees.

C_FT_COEFFICIENTS.statement: thm:coeff-finite: every allowed compact coefficient has finite continuous stabilizer cohomology at every height.

C_FT_DESCENT.statement: Finite coefficient cohomology, finite-page horizontal vanishing, and derived p-completeness imply finite generation of integral sphere homotopy.

C_FT_COUNTABILITY.statement: thm:pro-countability: all sufficiently deep fixed marking levels have countable cohomology in every degree.

C_FT_BOUNDARY.statement: lem:mark-strips: next-height coefficient finiteness gives finite boundary strips and countable localization kernel and cokernel for every fixed whole-lattice shift.

C_FT_ISOTROPY.statement: Finite-isotropy trace and continuous-cohomology arguments give a uniform cohomological bound for finite associated coefficients.

C_FT_GEOMETRY.statement: The completed marked tower has the claimed compact-support finiteness and invariant-constant calculation; these geometric inputs remain unaudited by this mission.

C_FT_COMPACT.statement: Laurent residues and positive-order acyclicity imply finite compact stable transfer images.

C_FT_STABILIZATION.statement: prop:pro-stabilization: consecutive transfer images stabilize modulo countable spaces with an exponent independent of sufficiently deep marking levels.

C_FT_INTERSECTION.statement: prop:cutoff-compact with consecutive-image stabilization identifies the actual localized intersection with a finite compact image.

C_FT_TOP.statement: prop:pro-top-operation constructs one finite top Koszul operation with countable cokernel on a marking tail.

C_FT_BRIDGE.statement: At one fixed marking subgroup all allowed high coinduced extension operations agree up to nonzero constants with the fixed top operation, and natural roots transport a single boundary operator to give eq:pro-boundary-transfer.
C_FT_BRIDGE.proof_scope: Conditional on the recorded geometric lift-torsor, whole-model and invariant-unit inputs; independent review and citation attribution remain outstanding.

C_FT_HIGH.statement: lem:pro-high-transfer with its actual auxiliary actions: there exists U_* such that for every allowed q >= s the displayed composite is a nonzero scalar multiple of e_s in equivariant Ext.

C_FT_ALGEBRA.statement: For arbitrary d and integers q >= s >= 1, the power-subalgebra Frobenius pairing and the Koszul comparison send the coinduced top class, pulled back from N_s and pushed to k, to a nonzero generator.

C_FT_COMMON.statement: For any characteristic-p field, after a uniform subgroup U_0 acts trivially on ordinary translation Ext in degrees 0 through j, restriction to U_0^(p^j) kills the degree-j equivariant forgetting kernel.

C_FT_EXT_FINITE.statement: Over a finite coefficient field, equivariant Ext between finite translation representations is a finite set in every degree for a compact p-adic analytic auxiliary group.

C_FT_FINITE_EXT.statement: Finite-length Yoneda Ext equals ordinary Lambda-Ext, and finite equivariant extensions and their comparisons admit finite diagrams.

C_FT_ROOTS.statement: prop:trans-roots at a fixed marking base, including natural auxiliary actions, every finite diagram, and successive coinduction/root coherence.

C_FT_LIFT_TORSOR.statement: prop:mark-roots and the Honda identities identify the full marked lift torsor and all finite root quotients; this geometric input is not certified by the algebraic bridge audit.

C_FT_WHOLE_MODEL.statement: prop:mark-whole-model supplies the finite free integral algebra, finite etale localization, invariant idempotent and bounded whole-basis G-action used by the root and pole comparisons; its construction remains a geometric input.

C_FT_CARTIER.statement: prop:trans-cartier identifies normalized augmentation maps with scalar multiples of S^a at a common marking stage and gives a fixed whole-model pole bound.
